faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Collectorate Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Collectorate Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 1 CENTRE ADMINISTRATOR (SAKHI), 1 PSYCHO SOCIAL COUNSELLOR (SAKHI), 1 PARA MEDICAL PERSONNEL (SAKHI), 1 MULTI PURPOSE STAFF / COOK (SAKHI), 1 SECURITY GUARD / NIGHT GUARD (SHAKI), 1 DRIVER (1098) and 5 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Collectorate Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Official website of the District Collector's Office, Jangaon District) and send it to Inward Section, Ground Floor, Collectorate, Jangaon District, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - CENTRE ADMINISTRATOR (SAKHI): 18 to 50 years; PSYCHO SOCIAL COUNSELLOR (SAKHI): 18 to 44 years; PARA MEDICAL PERSONNEL (SAKHI): 18 to 44 years; MULTI PURPOSE STAFF / COOK (SAKHI): 18 to 44 years; SECURITY GUARD / NIGHT GUARD (SHAKI): 18 to 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per department guidelines for CENTRE ADMINISTRATOR (SAKHI), As per department guidelines for PSYCHO SOCIAL COUNSELLOR (SAKHI), As per department guidelines for PARA MEDICAL PERSONNEL (SAKHI), As per department guidelines for MULTI PURPOSE STAFF / COOK (SAKHI), As per department guidelines for SECURITY GUARD / NIGHT GUARD (SHAKI).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree, Diploma, B.Sc, GNM, 10th, Graduate, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Medical Test is mandatory for every candidate attending the exam.

faq.answer: Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written Examination. Interview. Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in Written Exam and/or interview Conducted.
